title: Buying his saxophone while playing bass with Holmes
summary: With Holmes's encouragement he bought an alto saxophone for fifty dollars and was soon playing it with the band; clarinet came first.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: Oh, where did you get your saxophone? My saxophone?

Well, I was playing bass with the same band, Professor Holmes. And he said, John, you have a man like you shouldn't be on the bass. I got a shell, see? And I got the shell, played the shell a while, and said, why don't you get your saxophone? I'll get you saxophone pretty cheap. So, a friend of mine was there at the time, they said, I know a fella in Yardin. Just came from New York with a saxophone. I just bought it. So, I gave him, they said he wanted fifty dollars for it, and I gave him fifty dollars to train pad, that he played alto saxophone. And that's the one he wanted me to play, he played alto.
And you played it with the Holmes band?
I played with the Holmes band. Well, I could play the clarinet, I could play clarinet. And about a month, I was going out with the band, with the saxophone.
So, you took up clarinet first?
First, yeah. E flat clarinet, I used to play in the brass band, I used to play for them a while.
